About.title: ORI - The New Era of BTC
About.subtitle: Next-generation on-chain store of value (SoV) designed for Degen & Gen Z.
About.summaryDescription: <0>ORI</0> is a new generation Proof-of-Work (PoW) store of value asset, designed to solve the inherent "value leakage" problem in the Bitcoin model. Through innovative <1>on-chain reverse flow mechanisms</1>, ORI redirects miner costs back into the system, achieving complete on-chain value closure and self-prosperity. Tokens are fairly mined from 0, with no premine, no VC, no team allocation - everything is decentralized and organization-free. <2>ORI is on-chain native BTC 2.0</2>.
About.introContent1: Bitcoin, as the first decentralized store of value (SoV) asset, proved the security and censorship resistance of PoW consensus. Its core security model relies on the global miner network's continuous investment in computing power to maintain blockchain immutability.
About.introContent2Detail: However, this model has a <0>structural flaw</0>:<1></1><2>Value Leakage Channel</2><3></3>To cover electricity, hardware depreciation, operating costs, miners <4>must continuously sell mined BTC for fiat currency</4>.
About.consequence2: •Long-term deflationary expectations diluted by real selling pressure
About.consequence3: •System depends on external resources (electricity, fiat) to maintain security
About.problemTitle: Problem Analysis: The 'Value Outflow' Nature of PoW
About.costResult: Need to sell BTC for fiat
About.conclusionContent: Bitcoin's security comes at the cost of "continuously paying real resources to the external world". This is not a bug, but <0>the inevitable cost of the PoW model</0>.
About.oriPhilosophyTitle: ORI Design Philosophy: Reverse Flow, Internal Value Circulation
About.oriQuestion: "What if miners' costs no longer flow off-chain, but are captured and reused by the system internally?"
About.oriAnswer: ORI's answer is: <0>Build an on-chain self-consistent value universe</0>
About.oriMechanism1: •Miners' "costs" <0>remain in the system as ORI tokens</0>
About.oriMechanism2: •Mining incentives and system maintenance form a <0>positive flywheel</0>
About.zeropreminePoint2: •<0>No premine, no private sale, no team allocation</0>
About.decentralizedPoint1: •Based on PoW, but cost settlement <0>independent of fiat</0>
About.decentralizedPoint2: •Miners get rewards through internal mechanisms, <0>no need to sell coins</0>
About.traditionalPow: Traditional PoW: [Mining] → [New coins] → [Sell for electricity] → [Value outflow]
About.minerAction: Provide computing power, pay on-chain costs
About.economicResultContent: System no longer depends on external input to maintain security and growth.
About.visionContent: ORI is not a negation of Bitcoin, but an <0>evolution</0>.<1></1>It retains the core advantages of PoW (security, decentralization)<2></2>while eliminating its biggest weakness (value leakage).
About.visionSummary: <0>ORI = On-chain BTC for Degen & Gen Z</0> Born on-chain, prosper on-chain, never bow to off-chain.
About.conclusionContent1: Bitcoin opened the door to decentralized store of value,<0></0>ORI closes the back door of "value outflow" on-chain.<1></1><2>The future is here, the era of on-chain self-consistent value is opening.</2>
About.finalMessage: <0>ORI: Leave off-chain, return to on-chain.</0><1></1><2>Start from 0, never compromise.</2><3></3>Innovation is quietly happening on BNB Chain!<4></4>Tribute to Satoshi Nakamoto and Hardhat Chad.
